description: This Java source file contains a JUnit 5 test class 'LoanAccountOwnerTransferBusinessStepTest' that tests the behavior of the 'LoanAccountOwnerTransferBusinessStep' component within the Apache Fineract project. It includes multiple test cases for different scenarios related to external asset owner transfers, handling transfer statuses, delayed settlements, and event notifications.

classes.name: LoanAccountOwnerTransferBusinessStepTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the 'LoanAccountOwnerTransferBusinessStep' class in the Apache Fineract project. It contains multiple test methods covering scenarios like no transfer, invalid transfer states, same-day transfers, buybacks, transfer eligibility, delayed settlements, and event notifications.
